item.title: Jim Bakker dies at 86. The former televangelist was tarnished by a sex sandal and a conviction for fraud and conspiracy.
item.description: Bakker was a preacher and fundraiser on television for more than 20 years, developing a following that numbered in the millions. He and his wife were at the peak of their popularity in March 1987, when the Charlotte Observer revealed that Mr. Bakker had a brief sexual encounter in 1980 with Jessica Hahn, a 21-year-old church secretary from New York.

item.title: Trump reverses course, says he won’t use taxpayer money for campaign-style ads
item.description: The president has faced backlash from Democrats and even some Republicans about the commercials. The president argued that the television spots, which included one that closely resembled an ad for his 2024 presidential campaign, and another of him and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth advocating for the Iran war, were “a rather standard thing to do.” But he said he had “decided to do the Patriotic Ads, among others, and pay for them myself, and with money I raised for MAGA, Inc.”

item.description: The activists were trying to block President Donald Trump’s $46.5 billion border wall expansion. They say more than 50 Customs and Border Protection agents raided their camp Monday and an excavator knocked down the tree, estimated to be 150 to 250 years old.
